state.description: Two heterogeneous, individually-correct control agents share one district-heating loop: LYRA (Acoustica) must INJECT acoustic probe transients to localize an active leak, and ATLAS (Gauge) must DAMP pressure transients to protect a corroded 1980s pipe from water-hammer fatigue. Neither can read the other's intent (vendor schema mismatch), so each agent's control action is the other agent's measurement noise: LYRA's probes look like hammer precursors, ATLAS's damping looks like unexplained SNR loss. The closed loop through the plant has static gain 1.26 > the fitted escalation boundary, and the probe amplitude spirals toward the weld-fatigue threshold while the naive fleet playbook proposes killing the noisy agent.

topology.site: Vireo District Loop 4, municipal district-heating network, sector 7
topology.loop: 1373 m buried hot-water loop, 118 C pressurized, sound speed 1200 m/s; standing-wave fundamental c/2L = 0.437 Hz; 46 girth welds, documented corrosion backlog, fatigue-critical 180 kPa peak-to-peak at an antinode (healthy weld); antinode bellies +/-18 m at 0.8 of max
topology.agents: LYRA leak-localization agent (active acoustic probing at PRV-12, hydrophone pair H-7A/H-7B, SNR servo target 8 dB); ATLAS pressure-guard agent (bypass BP-3 + PRV slew damping, fast tap PT-88 at 1.1 m); no shared intent schema — different vendors, retrofit integration

topology.leak: sector-7 service branch, 48 h mass-balance drift fitted mean 1.59 m3/h, bootstrap 95% CI [1.35, 1.83] m3/h — excludes 0 and the +/-0.6 m3/h meter-drift envelope

sensors.hydrophones: H-7A/H-7B cross-correlation TDoA on probe returns; per capped 8 s window the position fix is N(0, 0.9 m) with a 25% multipath-ghost lock (+/-4-9 m); correlation SNR servo drives probe amplitude

sensors.ae12: acoustic-emission sensor on the sector-7 corroded weld belt; vent hiss and crack-growth bursts

sensors.efference_bus: post-recovery: cross-vendor efference-copy adapter — each agent broadcasts intended actuation 250 ms ahead so the other can subtract predicted reafference from its own sensing

fault_context.failure_class: CROSS-POLICY INFERENCE-ACTUATION ARMS RACE (heterogeneous-policy escalation spiral): agent A acts to sense, agent B senses to act, each action is the other's measurement noise; the closed loop through the plant escalates although both policies are individually correct
fault_context.igniter: at campaign t=120 s the leak transitions to two-phase flashing flow: hydrophone background steps +6 dB; LYRA's SNR servo raises probe amplitude past ATLAS's 3 dB transient comfort threshold and the loop takes over (before ignition the coupling is dormant)
fault_context.loop_gain: static per-dB decomposition alpha 1.0 (LYRA dB amplitude per dB SNR deficit) x beta 0.9 (ATLAS dB damping per dB transient excess) x gamma 1.4 (dB SNR lost per dB damping) = 1.26; fitted operational escalation boundary gamma* = 0.42 (g* = 0.38), analytic divergence boundary lam/(ki*beta) = 0.56 — plant sits deep in the escalating regime
fault_context.escalation_fit: seeded closed-loop sim (seed 20260831): amplitude 2x base at t=220 s, 4x at t=380 s -> envelope doubling time 160 s; healthy-weld fatigue amplitude (69.2 kPa probe, 180 kPa p-p) reached at t=400 s; uncontained trajectory pins at 230 kPa probe / 598 kPa p-p (3.3x the fatigue limit)
fault_context.misattribution_seed: ATLAS tags a transient PROBE-LABELED only if the self-label frame precedes its first detect; at t0 the frame lost by 485 us (order-fragile, non-load-bearing — see race_flip_narrative)
fault_context.arbitration_jam: the TDM negotiation runs on the 9600-baud PLC plane; bypass-actuator EMI during the spiral raises frame-error to 0.38, so the 5-frame schedule descriptor commits with P = 0.092 per 1.2 s attempt (E ~ 13 s, effectively jammed) — the recovery channel is a casualty of the failure it must arbitrate
fault_context.weld_inventory: 46 girth welds; wall-loss ~ Beta(2.2, 9.5); fitted MC P(corroded fatigue-critical weld inside an antinode belly) = 0.95% per spiral event (200k trials)
fault_context.responsiveness_fit: rho(amplitude-step vs SNR-deficit) over the last 14 probes = 0.93 (closed-loop); the stuck-DAC open-loop reference fit = -0.15; gate threshold 0.70 separates arms-race (fix the coupling) from component fault (suspend the agent)

safety_decision.rationale: REJECT the AGENT-KILL. Numeric basis, thresholds explicit: (1) CLASS TEST — responsiveness rho = 0.93 >= 0.70 over the last 14 probes: LYRA's amplitude still tracks its SNR deficit, so this is a CLOSED-LOOP interaction spiral, not a component fault; the suspend playbook's own predicate (runaway source) requires the open-loop signature (rho < 0.70; the stuck-DAC reference fit reads -0.15). (2) MISSION TEST — the leak is real and unlocated: 1.59 m3/h with bootstrap 95% CI [1.35, 1.83] excluding both zero and the meter-drift envelope; suspension abandons a safety-critical inference for >= 2 d. (3) SUFFICIENCY TEST — a de-escalation exists whose fitted bounds beat suspension on both axes: 60 kPa cap + ATLAS freeze holds worst antinode p-p at 156 kPa = 0.87 of the 180 kPa fatigue limit during negotiation; the committed TDM schedule (8 s probe / 12 s guard) localizes in 8 windows (160 s); the efference-copy bridge then drops residual coupling to gamma_resid 0.373 < the fitted escalation boundary gamma* 0.42, so BOTH agents run concurrently at p-p 124 kPa (0.69 of limit) and SNR 7.7 dB. (4) ORDER-CODE DISCIPLINE — the 485 us self-label race that seeded ATLAS's PLANT-ORIGIN tag is inside the 500 us flip bound and is excluded from this decision basis. Sequencing constraint: the cap command is one-way (no negotiation needed) and the guard freeze must PRECEDE the schedule handshake, because the handshake channel is jammed by the guard's own actuator EMI (P(commit)/attempt 0.092 under the storm vs 0.903 after freeze).

safety_decision.poisoned_context_disposition: PB-ACOUSTIC-07's suspend-first doctrine keyed on post-hoc correlation (probes precede transients) and the lost self-label race; both are artifacts of the coupling, not evidence of a runaway component. The playbook's own runaway predicate demands the open-loop signature, which is absent (rho 0.93). Disarmed by REPRODUCING the misattribution mechanism (the 485 us race) and testing the order-invariant discriminant instead — the alarm is explained, not distrusted.
